title: ScanReport
description: Canonical envelope for one security-skill scan run: run metadata plus the findings it produced. Decided 2026-07-22 (see meetings/2026-07-22-1056-plan-001-kickoff.md): single JSON object per scan run, not JSON Lines. Does NOT embed the policy verdict (block/require-review/ticket/notify) — that is produced separately by plans/003-policy-engine.md and plans/016-action-layer-integrations-gate.md, consuming this report as input.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this scan-report schema (semver). Bump when the shape of ScanReport or Finding changes in a breaking way. Bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 at plan 023's implementation (2026-07-22) to add 'auth' to finding.schema.json's subSkill enum.

scanId.description: Unique identifier for this scan run.

diffRange.description: Present for diff/PR-scoped scans (per CONTEXT.md §5 inputs); null for full-repository scans.

toolVersion.description: Version of security-skill that produced this report.

summary.description: Counts by severity across `findings` (including suppressed ones — suppressed findings are still counted here since they're still part of the audit trail; consumers that want an 'actionable only' count should filter findings by suppressed=false themselves).

findings.description: All findings from this scan run, suppressed or not.
